Name: Lnh's YunXi Farm CP And PIF
Author: liunianhui
Description:
[center][size=4][color=#ffff00]接受地图绘制委托，如果你正在制作mod，需要找人绘制地图，那么请联系我。
Accept the commission of map drawing. If you are making mod and need to find someone to draw a map, please contact me.[/color]

[color=#00ff00]这是一个漂浮在空中的美丽农场，它的名字叫云曦。
在农场中可以钓到湖鱼。
农场里放置了许多矿车，开局即可使用，无需解锁矿车。（PIF版本没有矿车）
默认替换标准农场，可以在配置中修改。
还有一张额外地图，可以种植，装修。
CP版本和PIF版本可以同时安装，根据需要下载
This is a beautiful farm floating in the air, named YunXi.
You can catch Mountain fish on the farm.
There are many mining cars placed on the farm, Can be used from the beginning, no need to unlock.(The PIF version does not have mine cars)
Default replacement of standard farm, you can be modified in the config file.
There is also an additional map for planting and decoration.
CP version and PIF version can be installed simultaneously, download as needed.[/color]
